---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for LeIndex
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["type:feature", "state:needs-triage"]
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the pain point or missing capability.

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Use Case

How would you use this feature? What workflow does it improve?

## Priority

- [ ] P1-high (critical for next release)
- [ ] P2-medium (important for current milestone)
- [x] P3-low (nice to have)

## Affected Area

- [ ] area:parse (tree-sitter parsing)
- [ ] area:search (search engine)
- [ ] area:graph (dependency graph)
- [ ] area:storage (SQLite/libSQL)
- [ ] area:cli (command-line interface)
- [ ] area:mcp (MCP server)
- [ ] area:edit (code editing)
- [ ] area:onnx (neural embeddings)
- [ ] area:packaging (distribution)
- [ ] area:infra (CI/CD)

## Type

- [ ] type:feature (new capability)
- [ ] type:perf (performance improvement)
- [ ] type:refactor (code quality)
- [ ] type:docs (documentation)

## Additional Context

Any other context, screenshots, or examples that help explain the request.
